evidence.text: The attached preview and matching SVG show one continuous black outline, not three separate upright strokes joined by a base: a broad rounded U-shaped outer contour rises into two tall side uprights, while a taller central stem descends and branches into two diagonal arms that meet the inner sides of the outer contour near its lower portion. The outline encloses a central open space above a rounded-bottom interior. Commons identifies the asset as a digital vector depicting 山 in Shuowen seal-script style and links the original SVG. The two prior geometry descriptions in X-8ca9187219249f18234d and X-7fe7d67c6a0c81ecb724 are superseded: they misread this asset. This is a description of visible topology only; it makes no claim about ancient stroke lineage or historical transition.
